keyEvents.text: Pasquale Mazzocchi (Venezia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Venezia 1, Udinese 0. Toma Basic (Venezia) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Antoine Hainaut with a cross.
Own Goal by Matías Moreno, Venezia. Venezia 1, Udinese 1.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Udinese. Giorgi Chakvetadze replaces Jakub Piotrowski.
Goal! Venezia 2, Udinese 1. Kike Pérez (Venezia) left footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Pasquale Mazzocchi.
